Convert the re-tracked curve results to a depth time space with uncertainty

Source: R/curve2time_unc_anchor.R
curve2time_unc_anchor.Rd

Converts the re-tracked curve results from retrack_wt_MC function to a depth time space using an anchor date while also taking into account the uncertainty of the tracked astronomical cycle

Usage

curve2time_unc_anchor(
  age_constraint = NULL,
  tracked_cycle_curve = NULL,
  tracked_cycle_period = NULL,
  tracked_cycle_period_unc = NULL,
  tracked_cycle_period_unc_dist = "n",
  n_simulations = 20,
  gap_constraints = NULL,
  proxy_data = NULL,
  cycles_check = NULL,
  uncer_cycles_check = NULL,
  max_runs = 1000,
  run_multicore = FALSE,
  n_cores = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  genplot = FALSE,
  keep_nr = 2,
  keep_all_time_curves = FALSE,
  dj = 1/200,
  lowerPeriod = 1,
  upperPeriod = 4600,
  omega_nr = 6,
  seed_nr = 1337,
  dir = TRUE
)

Arguments

age_constraint

Age constraints (anchor points, e.g. radiometric dates) for the modelling run: a data frame with 7 columns and one row per constraint. Column 1: ID name (character); column 2: age (numeric, usually in kyr, in the unit of the output ages); column 3: age uncertainty in the same unit (the standard deviation for a normal distribution, the full width of the range for a uniform one); column 4: distribution of the age, "n" (normal) or "u" (uniform); column 5: depth of the constraint (in the depth unit of tracked_cycle_curve); column 6: depth uncertainty (full width of the range for a uniform distribution); column 7: distribution of the depth, "u" (uniform), "n" (normal) or "t" (trapezoidal, with column 5 then holding the string "min mode1 mode2 max"). Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

tracked_cycle_curve

Re-tracked cycle with its uncertainty (matrix or data frame, three columns): depth in column 1 (metres), the mean tracked frequency in cycles per metre in column 2 and its standard deviation (1 sigma) in column 3, e.g. the output of retrack_wt_MC. Rows with NA are dropped and the curve is interpolated to its median depth spacing. Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

tracked_cycle_period

Duration of the tracked cycle in kyr (single numeric value, > 0, e.g. 405 for the long eccentricity cycle), used to turn the tracked period into a sedimentation rate with curve2time. Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

tracked_cycle_period_unc

Uncertainty of tracked_cycle_period in kyr (single numeric value, >= 0): the standard deviation when tracked_cycle_period_unc_dist="n", the half-width of the range when "u". Required (Default=NULL gives an error).

tracked_cycle_period_unc_dist

Distribution from which the duration of the tracked cycle is drawn in every simulation (character): "n" normal or "u" uniform. Default="n".

n_simulations

Number of anchored age models to simulate (integer, > 0). Default=20.

gap_constraints

Hiatuses (gaps) to insert in the age models: a data frame with 4 columns and one row per gap. Column 1: duration of the gap (kyr); column 2: its uncertainty (kyr; the standard deviation for a normal distribution, the half-width of the range for a uniform one; negative draws are set to 0); column 3: depth of the gap (depth unit of tracked_cycle_curve), below which all ages are shifted by the drawn duration; column 4: distribution, "n" (normal) or "u" (uniform). NULL inserts no gaps. Default=NULL.

proxy_data

Proxy records used to check that the astronomical cycles are preserved after tuning (list of matrices or data frames, each with depth in column 1, in the unit of tracked_cycle_curve, and the proxy in column 2); in every run one record is picked at random, tuned with the simulated age model and analysed with analyse_wavelet. Only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=NULL.

cycles_check

Periods in kyr of the astronomical cycles (numeric vector) that must appear as peaks in the average wavelet spectrum of the tuned proxy_data for a simulation to be accepted. Only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=NULL.

uncer_cycles_check

Tolerance of each period in cycles_check, in kyr (numeric vector of the same length): a peak counts if it lies within cycles_check +/- uncer_cycles_check. Only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=NULL.

max_runs

Number of rejected simulations (in which the anchored astronomical ages do not match the age constraints) after which the age constraint that disagrees most often is dropped (integer, > 0). Default=1000.

run_multicore

Run the simulations in parallel on several cores (logical, TRUE or FALSE). Note that only the parallel version also checks the tuned proxy data for the cycles in cycles_check. Default=FALSE.

n_cores

Number of cores used when run_multicore=TRUE (integer); NULL uses an automatic, safe number (physical cores minus one, at most 4, and limited by the free memory), which can be changed with options(waverider.n_cores = ...). Ignored when run_multicore=FALSE. Results do not depend on the number of cores. Default=NULL.

verbose

Show a progress bar (logical, TRUE or FALSE). Default=FALSE.

genplot

Plot the age constraints (with their 2-sigma range) and the mean simulated age model with its 2-sigma envelope against depth (logical, TRUE or FALSE). Default=FALSE.

keep_nr

Minimum number of age constraints that are kept when constraints are dropped after max_runs rejections (integer, >= 1). Default=2.

keep_all_time_curves

Also return all generated age curves, including the ones rejected during the modelling run, as the last element of the output list (logical, TRUE or FALSE). Default=FALSE.

dj

Spacing of the periods of the wavelet transform of the tuned proxy data, in octaves (numeric, > 0; e.g. 1/200 gives 200 periods per doubling); smaller values give a finer period axis but take longer. Passed to analyse_wavelet; only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=1/200.

lowerPeriod

Shortest period of the wavelet transform of the tuned proxy data, in kyr (numeric, > 0; at least twice the sample spacing in time). Passed to analyse_wavelet; only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=1.

upperPeriod

Longest period of the wavelet transform of the tuned proxy data, in kyr (numeric, larger than lowerPeriod). Passed to analyse_wavelet; only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=4600.

omega_nr

Central angular frequency (omega_0) of the Morlet wavelet used on the tuned proxy data (numeric, > 0; larger values give a better period resolution and a poorer depth resolution). Passed to analyse_wavelet; only used when run_multicore=TRUE. Default=6.

seed_nr

Seed of the random number generator (integer), so that the Monte Carlo simulations can be reproduced. Default=1337.

dir

Direction of time with depth (logical): TRUE time increases with depth (younger at the top), FALSE time decreases with depth (the age model is reversed). Default=TRUE.

Value

The output is a list of 3 or 4 elements if keep_all_time_curves is set to TRUE then the list consist of the x-axis, all the fitted curves in a matrix format, the astrochronologically fitted age of the anchor, all the generated depth time curves if keep_all_time_curves is set to TRUE then the list consists of the x-axis, all the fitted curves in a matrix format and the astrochronologically fitted age of the anchor If genplot=TRUE then 3 plots stacked on top of each other will be plotted. Plot 1: the original data set. Plot 2: the depth time plot. Plot 3: the data set in the time domain. #'

References

Routines for astrochronologic testing, astronomical time scale construction, and time series analysis <doi:10.1016/j.earscirev.2018.11.015>

Author

Part of the code is based on the sedrate2time function of the 'astrochron' R package

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{


Bisciaro_al <- Bisciaro_XRF[, c(1, 61)]
Bisciaro_al <-
 astrochron::sortNave(Bisciaro_al, verbose = FALSE, genplot = FALSE)
Bisciaro_al <-
 astrochron::linterp(Bisciaro_al,
                     dt = 0.01,
                     verbose = FALSE,
                     genplot = FALSE)
Bisciaro_al <- Bisciaro_al[Bisciaro_al[, 1] > 2, ]

Bisciaro_al_wt <-
 analyse_wavelet(
   data = Bisciaro_al,
   dj = 1 / 200 ,
   lowerPeriod = 0.01,
   upperPeriod = 50,
   verbose = FALSE,
   omega_nr = 8
 )

 Bisciaro_al_wt_track[, 2],
 Bisciaro_ca_wt_track[, 2],

 Bisciaro_Mn_wt_track[, 2],
 Bisciaro_Mg_wt_track[, 2]
)

x_axis_bisc <- Bisciaro_al_wt_track[, 1]

bisc_retrack <- retrack_wt_MC(
wt_list = wt_list_bisc,
 data_track = data_track_bisc,
 x_axis = x_axis_bisc,
 nr_simulations = 500,
 seed_nr = 1337,
 verbose = TRUE,
 genplot = FALSE,
 keep_editable = FALSE,
 create_GIF = FALSE,
 plot_GIF = FALSE,
 width_plt =  600,
 height_plt = 450,
 period_up  =  1.5,
 period_down = 0.5,
 plot.COI = TRUE,
 n.levels = 100,
 palette_name = "rainbow",
 color_brewer = "grDevices",
periodlab = "Period (metres)",
x_lab = "depth (metres)",
add_avg = FALSE,
time_dir = TRUE,
file_name = "TEST",
run_multicore = TRUE,
output = 5,
 n_imgs = 50,
 plot_horizontal = TRUE,
 empty_folder = FALSE
)

proxy_list_bisc <- list(Bisciaro_al,
                    Bisciaro_ca,
                    Bisciaro_sial,
                    Bisciaro_Mn,
                    Bisciaro_Mg)




id <- c("CCT18_322", "CCT18_315", "CCT18_311")
ages <- c(20158, 20575, 20857)
ageSds <- c(28, 40, 34)
ages_unc_dist <- c("n", "n", "n")
position <- c(13.3, 7.25, 3.2)
anchor_thick <- c(0.2, 0.1, 0.1)
anchor_thick_unc_dist <- c("u", "u", "u")

ash_Bisc <-
 as.data.frame(
   cbind(
     id,
     ages,
     ageSds,
     ages_unc_dist,
     position,
     anchor_thick,
     anchor_thick_unc_dist
   )
 )

gap_dur = c(10, 20)
gap_unc = c(3, 10)
gap_depth = c(2.5, 9)
gap_unc_dist = c("n", "n")


gap_constraints_Bisc <-
 as.data.frame(cbind(gap_dur, gap_unc, gap_depth, gap_unc_dist))

cycles_checks <- c(110,40,22)
uncer_cycles_checks <- c(20,5,7)

curve2time_unc_anchor_res <-
 curve2time_unc_anchor(
 age_constraint =  ash_Bisc,
  tracked_cycle_curve =  bisc_retrack,
  tracked_cycle_period = 110,
   tracked_cycle_period_unc = ((135 - 110) + (110 - 95)) / 2,
  tracked_cycle_period_unc_dist = "n",
   n_simulations = 20,
   gap_constraints = gap_constraints_Bisc,
   proxy_data = proxy_list_bisc,
   cycles_check = NULL,
   uncer_cycles_check = NULL,
   cycles_check = cycles_checks,
   uncer_cycles_check = uncer_cycles_checks,
  max_runs = 1000,
   run_multicore = FALSE,
   verbose = FALSE,
   genplot = FALSE,
   keep_nr = 2,
   keep_all_time_curves = FALSE,
   dj = 1/200,
   lowerPeriod =1,
   upperPeriod =2500,
   omega_nr = 6,
   seed_nr=1337,
   dir=TRUE
 )
